title: dome-mirror delete-propagation Phase 0 → Phase 2 transition + backlog drain (DIRECTIVE-20260707-001)
problem: PROP-091 shipped the full dome-mirror delete-propagation logic on 2026-06-11 (three-guard rule: DELETE_PATTERNS match + git ls-files absent + past retention window) but it has sat in Phase 0 (config enabled=false, manifest-only) for 27 days. Meanwhile prune-integrity keeps generating ~20-40 stale monitor/integrity/*.json files/day that dome-mirror cannot propagate as deletions to FUSE. The Phase-0 backlog has grown to 1,135 candidates (2026-07-08T00:34 sentinel), each dome-mirror cycle (UTC 00:30/04:30/08:30) re-emits the same delete-sanity-gate abort, degrading sentinel signal-to-noise. A straight enabled=true flip would deadlock forever because 1,135 > abort_abs=500.

investigation_answers.part_A_pre_flip_verification: PASS. Walked the 5 latest sync-workspace-runs sentinels (2026-07-06T08-35 through 2026-07-08T00-34). All show delete_propagation.ran=false, mode=manifest-only, deleted=0, abort fired via delete-sanity gate. Candidate count growing monotonically 1091→1105→1105→1118→1135 (~26/day, matches directive's ~30-40/day estimate). Sampled paths (20/sentinel) are 100% DELETE_PATTERNS matches — 0 non-matching across all 5 sentinels. Latest-sentinel full-sample retention check: all 20 sampled paths are narrative-cite-audit-*.json, min age 23.8 days, 0 under the 14-day retention window. No false-positive risk in the visible sample; the three-guard rule already filtered the candidate set (category_total 1289 vs candidates 1135 → 154 category files correctly held back as within-retention or git-present).
investigation_answers.why_B1_over_B2: B1 (temporary abort_abs raise + self-drain) chosen per directive recommendation. Fully automated after 1 config commit; per_cycle_cap=200 self-limits blast radius to 200 deletions/cycle; single config revert rolls back to Phase 0 if anything goes wrong. B2 (operator bulk allow_cowork_file_delete) reaches the same end state but consumes operator session bandwidth.

proposed_fix: Two config commits on monitor/scripts/sync-workspace-step4c.config.json (git-owned, operator-writable). Commit 1 (THIS RUN): delete_propagation.enabled=true, abort_abs=500→1500 (temporary drain lever), per_cycle_cap=200 UNCHANGED (durable throttle), abort_pct_of_category=50 unchanged. Commit 2 (FOLLOW-UP, future tinker/operator run once a sentinel reports candidates<200): restore abort_abs=1500→500 to re-arm the PROP-051-class mass-delete disaster gate.
safety_gates: per_cycle_cap=200 UNCHANGED — at most 200 files delete per dome-mirror cycle regardless of backlog size. This is the durable blast-radius throttle and is NOT touched.

abort_pct_of_category=50 UNCHANGED — deletes still abort if candidates exceed 50% of the FUSE category file count. At drain start category_total≈1289 so 50%≈644; the 1500 abort_abs is the binding limit during drain, not the pct gate. As the backlog drains, category_total shrinks and the pct gate re-tightens naturally.
abort_abs=1500 is EXPLICITLY TEMPORARY. Restoring it to 500 after drain is a hard requirement (constraint restore_abort_abs_after_drain). Leaving it at 1500 removes the mass-delete disaster gate.
Rollback: single config push delete_propagation.enabled=false returns to Phase 0 manifest-only with zero FUSE behavior.
overwrite_propagation NOT touched (PROP-092 sibling stays Phase 0, per directive do_not_touch_overwrite_propagation constraint).
DELETE_PATTERNS NOT changed (all 6 stable; backlog is entirely existing patterns matching stale files).
test_plan: Behavioral: next dome-mirror sentinel (monitor/integrity/sync-workspace-runs-*.json) after the flip shows delete_propagation.ran=true AND deleted>0 (expect deleted≈200 = per_cycle_cap).

Drain monitoring (Part C): watch ~6-8 cycles; each deletes up to 200 until candidates<200. Confirm no sentinel deletes a within-retention or git-present file (cross-check any listed path against the corresponding *-archive.jsonl in git).
Post-drain: at least one sentinel with candidates<200 AND ran=true → steady state reached → trigger Commit 2 (restore abort_abs=500).
rollout_plan: Commit 1 (this run, tinker tinker-2026-07-08T02-40): enabled=true, abort_abs=1500. Drain begins next dome-mirror cycle.
Drain window (~1-2 days at quiet 3-cycle/day cadence, self-draining via per_cycle_cap=200): ~6 cycles to clear 1,135 candidates.
Commit 2 (follow-up): restore abort_abs=500 once a sentinel shows candidates<200. Future tinker run detects the steady-state sentinel and pushes the restore, OR operator does it.
Part C post-drain monitoring: 3 steady-state cycles; if candidates>200 ever recurs, flag in integrity's next report (prune-integrity running faster than expected or new DELETE_PATTERNS entry).
tradeoffs: During the drain window the mass-delete disaster gate is raised from 500 to 1500, a PROP-051-class relaxation. Mitigated by: (a) per_cycle_cap=200 unchanged caps per-cycle blast radius, (b) verified-clean Part A manifest (100% pattern match, all past retention), (c) the raise is temporary with an explicit restore step, (d) single-push rollback to Phase 0. The alternative (leaving Phase 0 indefinitely) grows the backlog ~26/day and degrades sentinel signal permanently.
estimated_impact: Drains 1,135-file FUSE backlog of stale monitor/integrity/*.json; restores dome-mirror sentinel signal-to-noise; completes the Phase 0→2 transition PROP-091 designed. Steady-state expectation post-drain: candidates<100/cycle, well within per_cycle_cap self-draining capacity.
why_human_needed: Config is operator-writable but the directive explicitly authorizes tinker to author + apply the config change (config_is_git_owned_operator_writeable constraint). The follow-up abort_abs restore is mechanical (triggered by candidates<200 sentinel).
verification_pattern: test "$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('monitor/scripts/sync-workspace-step4c.config.json','utf8')).delete_propagation.enabled)")" = true && echo FIXED || echo STILL_BROKEN
